title.en: Konyakusha ni Wasurerareta Watashi Ringoku no Koutaishi Denka to Gisou Konyaku suru Koto ni narimashita (※Tadashi, Denka no Honmei wa Watashi Mitai desu!?)
"24-ten" to Konyaku Hakisareta Reijou wa, Ringoku no Outaishi ni Kanpeki na Hanayome to Aisareru
Denka, Rien Zentei no Kekkon Seikatsu, Ika ga desu ka?
Kirawaremono no Reijou wa, Watashi ga Aishimashou. ~Imasara Dekiai shite Kite mo, Mou Osoi desu!~
Honmono no Seijo Janai to Bareta no ni, Outei Denka ni Semararete imasu
Hakushaku Reijou no Konyakusha wa Itsumo Shio Taiou, Unzari shita no de Shio Taiou Kaeshi Hajimemasu
Zetsumetsukigushu Hanayome Shiitagerareta Hime desu ga Ouji-sama no Noroi wo Hodoite Shiawase ni narimasu
Koi wo Shiranai Majo Minarai wa Wakeari Ouji to Mahou Mitai na Koi wo suru
Outaishi Denka wa Koukyuu ni Uranaishi wo Goshomou desu
Shi ni Modori no Sachiusu Reijou, Konse de wa Saikyou Last Boss Ogikei-sama ni Dekiaisaretemasu
Konyaku Haki shite Sashiagemasuwa - Dorobou Reijou to Oshiawase ni
Nariyuki de Konyaku wo Moushikonda Yowaki Binbou Reijou desuga, Nazeka Jiki Koushaku-sama ni Dekiai sarete Torawarete imasu
Jimi de Nekura na Watashi desu ga, Naze ka Ikemen-gaka kara Koibito Yaku wo Tanomarete Konwaku shiteimasu
Botsuraku Reijou na no ni Dai 2 Ouji ni Kyuukonsaretemasu
Shinigami Koushaku no Yatoware Tsuma ni narimashita ga, Kodomo-tachi ga Kawai sugite Mainichi Shiawase desu!
Hakushaku Reijou ni Natte Ojou-sama no Kekkon wo Buchikowashimasu!
